item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan gar dbang rang gling pas gnas chen shel ri phyug mo'i ngo mtshar zla gam phug nas gter du spyan drangs te/ slar las can bla grwa mang pos bskul ngor gshen bstan g.yung drung rab brtan gling gi bla brang du shog ser la zhal bshus shing / drung yig pa ni tshul khrims blo ldan nas bgyis shing / yi ge dang po'i byed po shi la zur un nas bris pas zab gsang bstan pa'i phrin las rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
